title: Neon Eclipse: Neo-Veridia
tagline: A high-octane cyberpunk visual novel of corporate betrayal, rogue wetware, and neural sync anchors.
description: In the rain-drenched subterranean shadows of Neo-Veridia, megacorporations harvest consciousness for the orbital Neural Net. Awakened with an anomalous black-market Neural Coherence anchor, you must navigate street syndicates, synthetic enforcers, and rogue netrunners to unveil the Ghost Protocol.
author: Cipher Architect

worldContext.loreSummary: Tiered into three distinct socioeconomic strata, Neo-Veridia is dominated by Omnicorp's orbital spires above, the bustling middle commercial boulevards, and the lawless rain-slicked Sub-Level 04 known as the Rust Gutters. The neural underworld trades in overclocked cyberdecks, forbidden memory shards, and synthetic adrenaline.

startingNodes.speaker: Vesper Vance
startingNodes.title: Vesper: Ghostwire Undercroft Jack-In
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
The hum of submerged liquid-nitrogen cooling conduits reverberates through your boots. Neon blue data cables snake across the floor like synthetic roots. Perched on an overturned server rack sits Vesper Vance, his cybernetic left optic glowing with cascading hex code.

He doesn't look up immediately as you step through the EMP insulation gate. His mechanical fingers dance across a floating holographic console before his gaze locks onto you with analytical chill.
startingNodes.dialogue:
You tripped three quantum tripwires on the way down, rookie. Either Omnicorp's wetware hounds are slipping, or you came here knowing exactly whose ICE you were stepping on.

Talk fast before I fry your optic drivers with a feedback burst.
choices: [Decrypt/Analytical]: Flash the encrypted biometric cipher given to you by the Rust Gutter contact.
[Subterfuge/Hacking]: Overclock your Neural Anchor and siphon his feedback burst into a dead-end buffer.
[Composure/Diplomatic]: Take a seat opposite him and slide a military-grade memory shard across the terminal.
[Combat/Defiant]: Prime your monowire whip and remind him that dead men don't collect finder's fees.

startingNodes.speaker: Kira Thorne
startingNodes.title: Kira: Acid Rain Alleyway Ambush
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Acid rain hisses against the rusted corrugated steel overhead. A puddle of stagnant oil reflects the crimson neon signs of a shuttered noodle stall. Stepping from behind the shadow of a colossal exhaust vent, Kira Thorne emerges, her twin thermal katanas humming at 400 degrees Celsius.

Her combat coat flares in the steam exhaust, cybernetic jawline glinting as her crimson optics calibrate directly onto your vitals.
startingNodes.dialogue:
You're five minutes late and you brought two corporate drone tails behind you. If I wanted to babysit suicide candidates, I would have signed back up with Kuroshio Security.

Draw your weapon, or stay behind me if you want to keep your chrome intact.
choices: [Combat/Aggressive]: Counter-strike the incoming corporate tracker drone before it can ping the network.
[Tactics/Analytical]: Point out the drone was an intentional decoy to flush out the sniper on the rooftop.
[Defiance/Combat]: Ignite your own thermal blade and tell her to worry about her own flank.
[Discipline/Tactical]: Form up in tactical breaching order and report the target perimeter clear.
